# Kolab

> Kolab is Nepal's creator marketplace. Businesses and brands find and hire verified content creators and influencers (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook), post paid campaigns or free events, and pay through Kolab-held escrow. Creators discover paid collaborations, apply with proposals, deliver content, and get paid to their Kolab wallet. The main product is the Kolab mobile app (iOS and Android); kolab.com.np is the public website.

Key facts:

- Market: Nepal (all cities); prices in Nepali Rupees (Rs.)
- Two sides: creators (influencers / content creators) and businesses (brands, cafés, shops, agencies)
- Payments: the business funds escrow up front; the creator is paid when the business approves the delivered work; disputes are handled by Kolab
- Trust: verified profiles, two-way reviews and ratings, in-app chat, reporting
- Contact: info@kolab.com.np

## Main pages

- [Home](https://kolab.com.np/): overview of Kolab for creators and businesses
- [About](https://kolab.com.np/about): who we are and why Kolab exists

- [For Brands](https://kolab.com.np/brands): hiring creators and running campaigns as a business
- [For Creators](https://kolab.com.np/content-creators): finding paid collaborations as a creator
- [Trust & Safety](https://kolab.com.np/trust-and-safety): verification, escrow payments, reviews, reporting
